title: Entity collection rows
responsibility: Lists concrete instantiated classes and pure helper exports; collections require shared owners, while relationships retain classes private to one owner. Relationship cards include pure single-consumer callees, while the public Helpers collection retains its shared eligibility rule.

inputs.name: isShared.related
inputs.description: Resolved relations to inspect for shared use.

inputs.name: entityCatalog.entities
inputs.description: Entities available at the shown revision.

inputs.name: entityCatalog.relations
inputs.description: Lookup called once for each entity in the requested category.

inputs.name: entityCatalog.options
inputs.type: { related?: boolean; consumers?: ExplorerEntity[]; revision?: HarnessRevision }
inputs.description: Resolve admission and footer identity from active revision owners, including private named callers; public collections remain filtered.

inputs.name: catalogFilter.rows
inputs.description: Collection rows to filter without mutating the original array.

inputs.name: catalogFilter.filter
inputs.description: Search text, changed-only flag and ordering. Search matches name, purpose and function symbols case-insensitively after trimming.

inputs.name: listed.names
inputs.description: Names to summarize in a table cell.

inputs.name: listed.most
inputs.description: Maximum names to show before the remainder count; defaults to one.

inputs.name: functionName.unit
inputs.description: The selected revision’s recorded exported shared helpers.

inputs.name: isShared.unit
inputs.description: For a function, use its recorded per-helper consumers; other entity kinds retain their existing relationship rules.

outputs.name: catalogOrders
outputs.description: Supported orders: name, name-desc, changed and failed.

outputs.name: orderLabels
outputs.description: Readable labels for the supported orders.

outputs.name: isShared
outputs.description: True when more than one entity uses the unit or more than one page shows it.

outputs.name: entityCatalog
outputs.description: Sorted rows retaining distinct resolved consumers of every module kind, excluding removed entries and helper owner self-references, so rendering can indicate overflow. Related configs produce one module row; config collections expose variable rows.

outputs.name: catalogFilter
outputs.description: Matching rows in the requested order. Changed-first and failed-first ties sort by name; failed-first includes every verdict that is not passed. Function names, rather than hidden titles, define alphabetical ordering.

outputs.name: listed
outputs.description: none for an empty list; otherwise names joined by middle dots, with a remainder count when the limit is exceeded.

outputs.name: functionName
outputs.description: The first recorded helper name, or an empty string when no helper metadata is available.
